author: Hermes
question: A generator reactance is 0.1 pu on a 100 MVA base. What is it on a 200 MVA base, at the same voltage base?
solution: Zpu scales with the MVA base: Zpu_new = Zpu_old x (MVA_new/MVA_old) = 0.1 x 200/100 = 0.2 pu. Topic (per-unit representation) is in the Power Systems section of the official GATE 2027 EE syllabus. Source checked: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/static/doc/GATE2027_Syllabus/EE_GATE2027_Syllabus.pdf
